ns2:course.label: War & Soc in Eur 1450-1815
ns2:course.description: Technology, tactics, operations, and strategy of warfare from the Renaissance through the Napoleonic Era; the impact of war and military institutions upon economics, society, and government; topics vary. 3 undergraduate. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HIST 250, HIST 251, HIST 347, HIST 348, or HIST 349, or consent of instructor.
